purpose: Verified intake catalog for research datasets and media sources considered by MovementScienceLab but not necessarily activated in a runtime or training adapter. Source verification does not authorize model use.
activationRule: A verified source remains intake-only until its license is compatible with the intended use, exact files are pinned, participant/time grouping is understood where relevant, an adapter is implemented, and the canonical data-source matrix is updated through review.

sources.name: REHAB24-6: A multi-modal dataset of physical rehabilitation exercises
sources.publication: Černek A, Sedmidubsky J, Budikova P, et al. REHAB24-6: Physical Therapy Dataset for Analyzing Pose Estimation Methods. SISAP 2024.
modalities: RGB video from two synchronized cameras
sources.licenseStatus: Academic/non-profit noncommercial research use only according to the Zenodo record; commercial use requires contacting the dataset provider.
activationBlockers: map joint/marker conventions to MovementScienceLab measurements
pre-specify which exercise/camera conditions are in scope
confirm intended use is permitted by noncommercial terms

sources.name: KERAAL low-back-pain physical rehabilitation dataset
sources.publication: Nguyen SM, Devanne M, Remy-Neris O, Lempereur M, Thepaut A. A Medical Low-Back Pain Physical Rehabilitation Database for Human Body Movement Analysis. IJCNN 2024.

videoManifest.note: Dataset is distributed in multiple groups; use provider files directly and record exact group/file checksums before analysis.

sources.licenseStatus: CC BY-NC-SA according to the official KERAAL dataset page.
notValidFor: generalization from low-back-pain rehabilitation to unrelated conditions without validation
activationBlockers: pin exact downloaded groups and checksums
do not treat sensor modalities as interchangeable without agreement validation

sources.name: IntelliRehabDS (IRDS)

videoManifest.note: The public Zenodo record exposes depth-image archives and SkeletonData.zip rather than ordinary RGB exercise video.

sources.licenseStatus: Associated article and code are CC BY 4.0; verify the Zenodo dataset record's file-level rights before redistribution or derived-data publication.
notValidFor: random repetition-level splitting that leaks subjects
activationBlockers: pin the exact Zenodo version and SkeletonData.zip checksum
separate measurement-quality variables from biological predictors
document handling of the partial recording for participant 217

sources.name: Multidisciplinary prediction of running-related injuries using machine learning
sources.publication: Wu H, Brooke-Wavell K, Barnes MR, et al. npj Digital Medicine. 2026;9:213.
sources.licenseStatus: Article and supplementary materials are presented under CC BY 4.0 unless a file-specific credit line states otherwise; verify the downloaded supplementary file notice before redistribution.
bestUse: external research benchmark after exact outcome/timing reconstruction
notValidFor: assuming 6181 weekly rows are independent participants
direct transfer of published sample-level performance into MovementScienceLab
activationBlockers: verify participant identifiers are preserved in processed supplements
verify weekly temporal order and exact prediction index
reconstruct prospective outcome timing without leakage
freeze outcome/horizon/features before inspecting reanalysis performance
use participant-grouped or otherwise dependency-aware evaluation rather than sample-level random folds
map published biomechanics variables to webcam variables only after measurement-method compatibility analysis
